messages:
marta: Sprint kickoff 4aa We have a two-day copy sprint to lock the tri-mode landing (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) + webinar signup module. Short, focused.
ryan: I'll put together concise hero lines + one-paragraph intros for each mode. Target: 140 char hero + 1-sentence subhead.
olivia: I'll make two visual variants: compact (single CTA) and exploratory (Compare modes panel). Fran will do micro-anim for modal.
fran (design): Will keep modal to < 5 bullets, include iconography for performance/cost/security.
sam (eng-runtime): Benchmarks committed: will deliver p50/p95/p99 latency and 1k-token unit cost for the Hosted reference workload by EOD tomorrow. We'll include basic methodology: model=rwkv-13b-like, seq=512, batch=1-8, GPU=A100.
ben (Growth Ops): Form routing plan: add hidden field lead_mode + utm_campaign. Quick JSON for QA routing: ```{
  "form_mode" : "{mode}",
  "route_map": {"hosted":"sd_selfserve","dedicated":"ae_queue","private":"enterprise_sales"}
}``` I'll wire test endpoints.
copybot: Hero copy suggestions (pick tone):
- Hosted: "Start shipping LLM features today \u2014 low-latency hosted API."
- Dedicated: "Reserved capacity for predictable throughput and budgets."
- Private: "Private control plane for VPC & on-prem inference."
ryan: Draft A/B variations (short):
A1 Hosted: "Ship LLM features faster — hosted API with predictable latency."
A2 Hosted: "Launch features fast. Pay per use, scale predictably."
B1 Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools. Consistent latency, known bill."
B2 Dedicated: "Commit capacity, guarantee throughput."
C1 Private: "Full control: VPC, KMS, audit logs."
C2 Private: "Air-gapped or VPC deployments with enterprise controls."
olivia: Modal microcopy (2-line bullets):
"Hosted — fastest time-to-value. No infra ops, simple API."
"Dedicated — reserved GPUs, SLA-backed latency targets."
"Private — customer-managed networking and compliance integrations."
copybot: CTAs (short): [Hosted] Try API, [Dedicated] Request Quote, [Private] Contact Sales
marta: For the landing benchmark panel, let's use a compact table and a one-sentence methodology line. Example table row: "Hosted profile — p99=120ms, p50=22ms, cost/1k= $0.09". Add footnote: "Measured on A100, seq=512, batch=4."
ryan: Social copy (under 140 chars) options:
- "Reduce inference cost, keep low latency. See real benchmarks + live demo. Register: [link]"
- "Hosted, Dedicated, Private — one API surface. Join our webinar to see why. [link]"
- "New: tri-mode inference options for production LLMs. Live benchmarks & demo. [link]"
fran (design): FAQ snippet idea for "Private vs Dedicated":
"Private = customer network + KMS; Dedicated = Redwood-hosted reserved capacity. Both offer SLA options; choose based on compliance needs"
sam (eng-runtime): Quick quote for launch post: "We focused on predictable tails and workload-aware batching to bring p99 latency down without sacrificing cost." Will confirm exact percent improvement.
ben (Growth Ops): Launch schedule draft: teaser (5 days out), benchmarks snapshot + blog (3 days out), webinar invite (2 days out), last reminder (day of). I'll create UTMs: utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch_v2.
marta: Decision points: 1) Use A1 for product blog hero, B1 for enterprise landing; 2) Include mini-bench table + methodology; 3) Modal on "Compare modes" with bullets + demo CTA.
ryan: I'll post final copy drafts tomorrow morning. Olivia/Fran push visual variants then. Ben, wire routing to staging. Sam, confirm bench numbers.
copybot: Micro-test suggestion: expose 3 variants for first 1k visitors: hosted-hero-A, hosted-hero-B, compare-modal-on-load. Measure signups and demo clicks.
marta: Action items summarized:
- sam: bench numbers & quote (EOD tomorrow)
- ryan: hero + banner copy + social blurbs (tomorrow am)
- olivia/fran: visuals + modal mock (tomorrow pm)
- ben: form routing + UTMs to staging (today)
- marta: assemble canonical copy doc and publish on Google drive when all final
ryan: small ask 4ac can we make the hero subheads mention a concrete stat when possible (eg "lowers per-token cost by up to 40% vs baseline") — we'll only put numbers if bench supports it.
marta: Agreed. Keep any numeric claims footnoted with methodology.
ben (Growth Ops): I'll run an initial QA on routing and share a test submission link.
marta: Thanks team. Quick reconvene tomorrow 11am PT if everything lands. :thumbsup:
